title: Historic Regional Locatives: Erdélyben, Felvidéken, Kárpátalján

sections.title: Locative Suffix Harmony for Historical Regions
sections.content: You know -ban/-ben and -on/-en/-ön from A1. No rule says which of the two a region takes: learn each name with its ending. *Erdélyben* and *a Vajdaságban* take -ban/-ben, but *a Felvidéken* and *Kárpátalján* take -on/-en/-ön, and for Burgenland both *az Őrvidéken* and *Burgenlandban* are used.
